expression: frappe.set_route('query-report','漏科目检查',{company:'_FCT S6 界面验证',fiscal_year:'2025',month:'3'}); true;

(()=>{const text=document.body.innerText;const rows=frappe.query_report.data;const column=frappe.query_report.columns.find(column=>column.fieldname==='balance_or_movement');if(!text.includes('¥ 25.00')||rows[0].currency!=='CNY'||column.options!=='currency')throw new Error('人民币金额显示验证失败');return {symbol:frappe.model.get_value(':Currency','CNY','symbol'),filters:frappe.query_report.get_filter_values(),rows,options:column.options,amount:'¥ 25.00'};})()
